parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
    UPDATE app.reels
    SET
        status = 'downloading',
        download_started_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::BIGINT
      AND status IN ('received', 'download_failed')
    RETURNING
        id,
        shortcode,
        original_url,
        telegram_chat_id,
        status,
        TRUE AS claimed
), existing AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        shortcode,
        original_url,
        telegram_chat_id,
        status
    FROM app.reels
    WHERE id = $1::BIGINT
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT claimed FROM claimed), FALSE) AS claimed,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing) AS reel_exists,
    COALESCE((SELECT id FROM claimed), (SELECT id FROM existing)) AS id,
    COALESCE((SELECT shortcode FROM claimed), (SELECT shortcode FROM existing)) AS shortcode,
    COALESCE((SELECT original_url FROM claimed), (SELECT original_url FROM existing)) AS original_url,
    COALESCE((SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM claimed), (SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM existing)) AS telegram_chat_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT status FROM claimed), (SELECT status FROM existing)) AS status;

parameters.text: =⏳ Reel registrado. Iniciando download...  ID: {{ $json.id }} Shortcode: {{ $json.shortcode }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE app.reels
SET
    status = 'downloaded',
    title = $2,
    creator = $3,
    caption = $4,
    duration_seconds = $5::NUMERIC,
    filename = $6,
    mime_type = $7,
    file_size_bytes = $8::BIGINT,
    sha256 = $9,
    storage_provider = $10,
    storage_bucket = $11,
    object_key = $12,
    downloaded_at = $13::TIMESTAMPTZ,
    error_message = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::BIGINT
  AND status = 'downloading'
RETURNING
    id,
    id AS reel_id,
    shortcode,
    original_url,
    status,
    telegram_chat_id,
    filename,
    file_size_bytes,
    storage_bucket,
    object_key,
    downloaded_at;

parameters.query:
UPDATE app.reels
SET
    status = 'download_failed',
    error_message = $2,
    retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    last_error_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::BIGINT
  AND status = 'downloading'
RETURNING
    id,
    shortcode,
    original_url,
    status,
    telegram_chat_id,
    error_message,
    retry_count;
